newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Hellaby to drop K&S stake further.
newsitem.headline: Hellaby to drop K&S stake further.

text.p: Hellaby Holdings Ltd said on Friday it would reduce its stake in up-market Wellington department store Kirkcaldies and Stains to 26 percent, against original plans to drop its stake to 40 percent.
Hellaby currently holds 51 percent of the department store.
The company recently made 550,000 of its shares available to existing shareholders (11 percent of issued capital), but received applications for 1,250,000 shares.

"Rather than scaling back the number of shares sought, Hellaby Holdings has decided to accept all applications in fully, thereby reducing its holding in Kirkcaldies and Stains to 1,300,000 shares (26 percent of issued capital)," the company said in a statement.
The applications came from 420 of the company's 1,600 shareholders.
Hellaby announced on June 3 it would sell shares at NZ$3.00 each, for settlement on July 21. The shares were trading at $2.42 early on Friday afternoon.
